definitions.explanation: Shoes worn inside buildings, especially the canvas slip-on shoes worn by students in Japanese schools.

examples.japanese: {上履|うわば}きに{履|は}き{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I changed into my indoor shoes.

examples.japanese: {上履|うわば}きを{忘|わす}れてきた。
examples.english: I forgot to bring my indoor shoes.

examples.japanese: {新学期|しんがっき}に{新|あたら}しい{上履|うわば}きを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought new indoor shoes for the new school term.

notes:
In Japanese schools, students change from outdoor shoes to {上履|うわば}き when entering the building. These are typically white canvas slip-on shoes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上履|うわば}きに{履|は}き{替|か}える: to change into indoor shoes
- {上履|うわば}きを{洗|あら}う: to wash indoor shoes
